purpose: Recheck the Round 18 field checks against the exact documents they cite.

zx3Verdict.values: All seven stored fields are stated verbatim in the manual specification table (p. 10).
zx3Verdict.statuses: Unchanged. Every field already had MANUFACTURER_VERIFIED and the document supports each one independently; no field was promoted because a sibling field was verified.
defectsFound: Page reference said p. 3; the specification table is on p. 10.
Sensitivity note claimed "95 dB full-space", which the manual does not state.
Active note quoted a "System Configuration" row not present in the manual, and misquoted the connector row.
Power note called the row "Full-Range" instead of "Power Handling (Passive)".

presonusVerdict.values: R65 and R80 driverCount, active, woofer and frequency response match the manual; power matches the tech sheets; sensitivity and load impedance remain UNAVAILABLE with reasons recorded.
presonusVerdict.host: www.fmicassets.com stays ESTABLISHED under the owner confirmation of 2026-10-13; unchanged.
defectsFound: R80 woofer provenance did not record why 8 in is kept against the tech sheet table row that says 6.5 in.
